content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"parsnip_planted_and_watered":true}]},"modes":[{"id":"mode","priority":10,"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push([x, y]); } } for (const [x, y] of tiles) { b.log('Working tile ' + x + ',' + y); let r = await b.workTile(x, y, 0, 'ControllerX'); b.log('till: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 2, 'ControllerA'); b.log('plant: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 1, 'ControllerX'); b.log('water: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); } }","check":"async (b) => { const obs = await b.observe(); return { ok: /parsnip/i.test(obs) && /water/i.test(obs), detail: obs.slice(0, 400) }; }"}]}
